# MusicRadar

> > MusicRadar is a comprehensive music technology and equipment resource covering gear reviews, artist news, production tutorials, and buying guides for musicians and producers worldwide.

MusicRadar provides in-depth coverage of music equipment across all instrument categories, featuring reviews from major brands like Roland, Fender, Gibson, and Yamaha. The site combines gear journalism with artist interviews, production tutorials, and curated buying guides for musicians at all levels.

## Key Topics

- Equipment Reviews
- Music Production
- Synthesizers
- Guitar Gear
- DJ Equipment
- MIDI Controllers
- Studio Recording
- Keyboards & Pianos
- Drum Kits
- Music Tech
- Bass Guitars
- Acoustic Guitars
- Artist News
- Music History
- Buying Guides

## Core Equipment Reviews

- [Music Gear and Equipment Reviews](https://www.musicradar.com/reviews): In-depth music equipment reviews: Laney, Erica Synths, gear buying guides
- [Guitars Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/guitars): Guitar news, reviews, amps and pedals coverage with latest breaking updates
- [Tech Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/music-tech): Music tech hub: synths, keyboards, recording gear, DJ equipment coverage

## Instruments & Gear Categories

- [Synths Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/music-tech/synths): Synthesizer news, reviews and coverage from Baby Audio, Roland, The Prodigy
- [Keyboards & Pianos Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/music-tech/keyboards-pianos): Keyboards, pianos and synthesizers from Yamaha, Fender, Gibson, PRS
- [Drums Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/drums): Drum kits and equipment coverage: Mapex, DW, Roland electronic drums
- [DJ Gear Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/music-tech/dj-gear): DJ equipment news: controllers, mixers, turntables from Arturia, Roland, Rane
- [Guitar Amps Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/guitars/guitar-amps): Guitar amp reviews and guides: Laney Prism Mini, Victory PowerValve 200
- [Acoustic Guitars Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/guitars/acoustic-guitars): Acoustic guitar reviews and guides: Taylor, Martin, Gibson, Fender models
- [Bass Guitars Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/guitars/bass-guitars): Bass guitar news and reviews featuring Les Claypool, Metallica, Isley Brothers

## Production & Studio Technology

- [Recording Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/music-tech/recording): Studio equipment, microphones, monitors and recording gear from Bose, Moog
- [Software & Apps Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/music-tech/software-apps): Music software, DAWs, plugins from Native Instruments, iZotope, Spotify
- [Controllers Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/music-tech/dj-gear/controllers): DJ controllers and MIDI gear news: Arturia Keystep 37, Rane System One

## Learning & Guides

- [Tutorials Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/tutorials): Music production tutorials, guitar lessons, theory and audio engineering guides
- [Latest Music Buying Guides](https://www.musicradar.com/buying-guides): Equipment buying guides for guitars, keyboards, studio gear from major brands

## Artists & Music News

- [Artists Coverage](https://www.musicradar.com/artists): Latest artist news, interviews and coverage featuring Bee Gees, Robert Smith
- [Lennon vs McCartney: Beatles Songwriting Credits and Composition Dispute](https://www.musicradar.com/artists/it-was-johns-original-inspiration-i-think-my-melody-i-think-my-guitar-riff-thats-my-recollection-lennon-might-have-written-the-lyrics-but-as-mccartney-remembers-it-he-wrote-the-tune-to-one-of-the-beatles-greatest-and-most-poignant-songs): Beatles songwriting history: Lennon-McCartney composition credits dispute
- [When Sylvester Stallone Wanted Another Eye Of The Tiger for Rocky](https://www.musicradar.com/artists/i-read-the-movie-script-sitting-around-poolside-at-a-hotel-then-frankie-and-i-went-to-my-room-and-wrote-the-song-on-an-old-wurlitzer-piano-when-sylvester-stallone-wanted-another-eye-of-the-tiger-for-his-next-rocky-movie-he-knew-who-to-call): Songwriter interview: Jim Peterik and Frankie Sullivan on Rocky soundtrack
